steps.content: This "academic exchange" is proving to be quite a marathon. Your chaos-forged combat instincts collide with Summer's unhinged creativity, and the result is what can only be called an unholy mess of a strategy.
And yet, remarkably, the other side rises to meet it. The duel rages on, unrelenting, feeding on its own momentum.

steps.speaker: Research Assistant
steps.content: Ah, um... That was a very meaningful exchange! You're both incredibly impressive—truly evenly matched. But Professor Lambert's presentation next door has already wrapped up, so perhaps we should also...

steps.speaker: Lemma
steps.content: Shut it! I'm not finished!

Lemma stares dead at the screen. There's a faint sheen of sweat on her brow, and her shoulders are coiled with tension. However, she refuses to yield. She strikes the keys at an astonishing pace, the exchange now too quick for the crowd to follow.

steps.speaker: Lemma
steps.content: Accounting for the margin of error, the simulation data he's presented holds up. Mania as a whole is intensifying; the fluctuations are violent, and the interference with existing shielding tech is getting worse by the day.
steps.female_content: Accounting for the margin of error, the simulation data she's presented holds up. Mania as a whole is intensifying; the fluctuations are violent, and the interference with existing shielding tech is getting worse by the day.

steps.speaker: Lemma
steps.content: Tch. Only a few months, and it's already deteriorated this far. Even if we accelerate model iteration by 203%... can we keep up...? No. It's only going to get worse from here. We have to solve this at a more fundamental level...

steps.speaker: Lemma
steps.content: ...We don't have a choice. We need a breakthrough. I...

She lowers her voice, but her gaze remains fixed ahead. The trio behind her is clearly flagging. Still, each time their unwavering little leader delivers an order, they would look at one another, then quickly throw themselves back into the fray.

On the other side, Summer has caught fire. She dives deeper and deeper into the game, her glee escalating with it. She's all but left you in the dust now. As you look towards your opponents, you can't help but feel amazed, followed by a surge of another emotion entirely. The words escape of their own accord—

steps.speaker: Lemma
steps.content: Huh?

The improvisation. The focus. The decisiveness and sheer persistence. The way she learns at lightning speed and applies each lesson instantly. And the absolute, unquestioning trust her team members have in her leadership.

One could dismiss Summer's extraordinary intellect as the work of Mania. This girl, however, is no Sinner. Despite that, she radiates something almost none can deny: unmistakable and undeniable <color=#fb9259>genius</color>.
This child has real talent.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Your technical skills, your analysis, and that brain of yours are all top-tier. With talent like that, why aren't you out supporting the front lines? FAC and the rest of us would kill to have someone like you. You could make a real difference out there!
For a split second, Lemma falters. Out of all things, she hadn't prepared for you to praise her as such.
But she pulls herself together just as quickly, her features settling back into that familiar scowl.

steps.speaker: Lemma
steps.content: Are you serious? This is just a simulated combat environment. Everything's idealized. Real combat is something else entirely. There are way too many variables in this field. If something goes wrong because it wasn't properly tested, people die! A lot of them.

steps.speaker: Lemma
steps.content: This is not enough. Not even close... Just let me run one more set...
A hand firmly presses down on hers, stopping her in her tracks.

steps.speaker: Research Assistant
steps.content: Alright, Chief Scientist. The guests will be returning soon. How about we leave it there for now? You and the Chief can continue this discussion somewhere else. Take your time.

steps.speaker: Research Assistant
steps.content: Hitting a bottleneck is part of the process. Pushing too hard won't get you the results you're after.
Right. You've nearly forgotten that this is someone else's event. Looks like the time has come to pack it in.

You start drafting a request to EDGE in your head. You'd love nothing more than to borrow this kid for a couple of weeks, maybe ten days, even, whatever they'd approve. Imagine if she and Summer joined forces. The Bureau would practically have rockets strapped to it.

Lemma stops. She glances back at the assistant who intervened, her expression one of clear displeasure. You brace yourself for another show of arrogance from this blonde brat, but when she speaks, her voice is ice-cold.

steps.speaker: Lemma
steps.content: ...You're making me sick. I've had my fill of being your entertainment.

steps.speaker: Lemma
steps.content: Every single one of you... Is this what you so-called adults who can't be bothered with real work enjoy? Dressing up and putting on little performances, <color=#fb9259>Isomer</color>?!
A whistle escapes Summer. The three children across, too, are visibly thrown. They look at one another, bewildered, before their gazes converge on the two standing by the podium.
The so-called "assistant" laughs softly, as if she's just stumbled upon some rare amusement. When she speaks, her voice sounds entirely different.

steps.speaker: Research Assistant
steps.content: We already have geniuses like you in charge of academic research. Naturally, I'd need to find other ways to keep myself occupied, wouldn't you agree?

steps.speaker: Research Assistant
steps.content: For instance, all those menial tasks the Chief Scientist can't be bothered with. I'm more than happy to pick those up.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...You're...
The woman loosens her collar and removes her glasses. With a casual sweep of her hand, she brushes the hair from her eyes, then straightens to her full height as she fixes her gaze directly on you.
The mild-mannered researcher who guided you through the exhibition hall has vanished without a trace. Before you now stands someone else entirely.

steps.speaker: Research Assistant
steps.content: Greetings, Chief of the MBCC. I'm Isomer, current Director of the Ring Research Institute.

steps.speaker: Research Assistant
steps.content: It seems I've finally found the "right moment" to introduce myself. It's a pleasure to meet you.

Isomer
Honorary Dean of the College of Science and Engineering, United University
Director of Ring Research Institute
Chief Advisor of BR-003 Observation Hub
